description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-e-Punjab proudly marked its presence at the Zibika Exhibition by promoting the handcrafted products created by the talented specially-abled of Together Foundation.

The exhibition provided a valuable platform to showcase the artisans' creativity, craftsmanship, and entrepreneurial spirit to a wider audience. Every product on display represented not only traditional skills but also the journey of striving towards financial independence and sustainable livelihoods of the specially-abled.

Through this initiative, the club reaffirmed its commitment to community development by supporting local artisans, foundations and encouraging visitors to appreciate and purchase products made with skill, passion, and purpose.
